title: Epic: Implement spec 19 device HMI design language
description: Implement all normative requirements from spec/19-device-ux.md across three hardware tiers (E=e-ink, O=OLED, H=headless). 75 requirements covering: screen ring navigation, button interaction grammar, LED language, SOS semantics, status bar, power budget, styling tokens, string table, Meshtastic compatibility, and tiebreaker process.
